headings: Sign in or create your account
walls.note: The field was empty. Continue was not clicked. Passkey, Apple, and Google were visible and were not clicked. The address bar carried a token query after the redirect. The screenshot shows no token and no typed value. The token is not recorded.

walls.title: Best Buy: Create an Account
walls.note: Every field was empty. Create an Account was not clicked. Password visibility was not toggled. Google was not clicked. The address bar carried a token query after the redirect. The screenshot shows no token and no typed value. The token is not recorded. A direct visit to /identity/newAccount without that redirect returned an error page and was not photographed.
